data.description:
# Code-review verdicts never record provider_provenance

## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/sidecar.py:106` reads `verdict.get("provider_provenance")`, but the
code-review verdict NEVER sets that key, so every signed code-review verdict records it as absent.
This is the SAME defect that story 343b found and fixed for the plan-review and completion gates
(343b gap 5); code review was left out of that change deliberately to keep it reviewable.

VERIFIED IN SOURCE at commit b872bc3c89:
- The terminal verdict is assembled by `code_review_coach`
  (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py:500-532`); its return dict carries
  verdict/blocking/advisory/coaching/coverage/dropped/indeterminate and no provenance.
- `finalize_code_review_verdict` then adds only cfg-derived fields:
  `verdict.setdefault("runner", runner_sel.name)` and `verdict.setdefault("model", cfg.model)`
  (`src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py:244-245`). Exactly the cfg-derived shape 343b removed
  from plan-review.
- The outage path `_degraded_code_review_verdict` (`workflow/gate_dispatch.py:246-257`) sets
  `runner` only.

CONSEQUENCE: the epic's acceptance criterion "A signed verdict states which provider, endpoint host,
and support tier produced it" holds for two of the three gates. A code-review verdict produced
through Bedrock, or behind an OpenAI-compatible gateway, still records only a bare model string --
the misattribution the provenance record exists to remove. This matters most for the review bot,
which is the S8 Bedrock cutover target.

## Approach
Mirror what 343b did, and reuse its mechanism rather than inventing a second one:
`capabilities.provenance_for` assembles the record ONCE inside the runner
(`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:388`) and `findings.finalize_outcome` stamps it onto every per-call
result (`findings.py:312-313,343-344`). An AGENT step's outputs are the runner result VERBATIM
(`workflow/runs.py:262`), and 343b made `_dispatch` default the key to None when no provider
resolved, so `${{ steps.<agent>.outputs.provider_provenance }}` resolves for code review too.

So the shape is: wire the record from code review's own Pass-2 `verify` agent step through to
whatever assembles the terminal verdict, and set the key only when it is present.

DO NOT recompute the record at the verdict site. `capabilities.provenance_for`'s docstring
(`capabilities.py:295-300`) forbids it: a recomputed record can diverge from the one that actually
drove the run, which is the prior regression it must not repeat.

DO NOT try to carry it through the usage aggregate. `sizing.usage_record` (`sizing.py:272-290`)
builds each per-call record from the runner result's `_usage` SUB-DICT only, and the provenance
lives at the result's TOP level, so it is dropped before aggregation. 343b established this dead
end; do not re-derive it.

HONEST VALUE WHERE NOTHING RAN: `_degraded_code_review_verdict` is the outage path -- no model ran,
so it must OMIT the key rather than synthesize one from cfg. 343b applies the same rule at its three
no-record sites.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py` (298 LOC) and/or
  `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py` -- whichever holds the assembly seam.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml` -- the wire from the verify step.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:246-257` -- the outage path, comment only.
- a test file under `tests/unit/`.

## Testing
THE ORACLE MUST NOT HAND-BUILD A VERDICT. That is precisely why 343b gap 5 shipped broken: every
test handed `build_payload` a verdict that already contained the key, proving the persist step and
never the path. Model the tests on `tests/unit/test_verdict_provenance_wiring.py`:
- assert the gate YAML actually WIRES the record, from a step that is an AGENT step (only an agent
  step's outputs are the runner result verbatim; sourcing from a scripted op silently wires None);
- assert on a verdict produced by the REAL assembly path, then fed to the REAL sidecar payload
  builder;
- a control asserting the outage path omits the key rather than inventing one.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] a test asserts a code-review verdict produced by the real assembly path carries
      `provider_provenance`, and that the real sidecar payload built FROM that verdict records it
- [ ] a test asserts `code-review.yaml` wires the record from an AGENT step, not a scripted op
- [ ] a test asserts the degraded/outage code-review verdict OMITS the key rather than deriving one
      from cfg
- [ ] `grep -n "setdefault(\"model\"" src/rebar/llm/code_review/finalize.py` is accompanied by a
      provenance assignment, i.e. the verdict no longer records a bare model string alone
- [ ] every file touched stays at or under the 800-LOC cap in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`
